enable_language(C)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb_image.h" _stb_image_actual)
if(NOT _stb_image_actual STREQUAL "594c2fe35d49488b4382dbfaec8f98366defca819d916ac95becf3e75f4200b3")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "stb_image 2.30 source hash mismatch: stb_image.h")
endif()
add_library(ludus_stb_image STATIC stb_image_impl.c stb_image_allocator.c)
set_target_properties(ludus_stb_image PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 EXPORT_NAME StbImage POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(ludus_stb_image SYSTEM PUBLIC "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}>")
install(TARGETS ludus_stb_image EXPORT LudusTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
install(FILES LICENSE DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/Ludus/licenses" RENAME stb-LICENSE.txt)
